profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary: Multitalented, savvy IT professional with close to 2 decades of experience seeking opportunity to add value and become an essential asset to your organization by leveraging my technical knowledge and versatile skillset.

company.name: St. Jude Children's Research Hospital - ALSAC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Researched, documented and implemented all of the necessary steps required to successfully migrate existing .NET applications off of Windows 2008 server and onto Windows Server 2019
-	Refactored inherited ETL processes written in Python to automate and make production-ready and easier to maintain long term. 
-	Worked to establish a SSDT project for the team’s shared database and collaborated with the DevOps team to set up a CI/CD pipeline using TFS to automatically deploy after commits are pushed in Git
-	Developed new features and improvements to the API and front end applications owned by our team using C#, MVC, and Entity Framework
-	Investigated ongoing incorrect assignments produced by the API, determine logic changes in t-SQL needed to reduce the volume of incorrect assignments which resulted in about a 30% reduction in bad assignments and improving data quality
-	Tested API changes using both a web browser and Postman 
-	Implemented data validations and multiple improvements to the SourceCode Bulk Upload SSIS package to improve the user experience and reduce the number of production support tickets
-	Set up a brand new process to allow business users to submit Package cost updates through an automated SSIS Package that eliminates my team’s need to perform the same work through production support
-	Write and execute ad-hoc SQL queries to analyze data and troubleshoot issues as they arise and find ways to resolve them
-	Documented technical processes to help myself and others better understand inherited processes through the uses of Confluence, Jira, Visio and/or Word
-	Co-lead the Python Learners Group for the past several months and lead several sessions personally

positions.title: Senior Manager Commercial Services Analytics Data Management Warehouse
positions.description:
- Manage a team of up to 8 IT contractors responsible for the day to day operations of the CSAT environment
- Responsible for recruiting, interviewing, hiring and firing contractors as needed to support our team
- Perform knowledge transfer and training sessions to new contractor resources to make them effective faster
- Serve as subject matter expert for a large majority of our server environment and datasets
- Understand actions and their impacts to our environment to eliminate or reduce side effects from requested changes
- Investigate data related issues through use of prior knowledge and ad hoc analysis to determine root causes
- Suggest possible solutions to issues as they arise and execute on the agreed plan to resolve them
- Facilitate ongoing server maintenance to insure the scheduling has minimal impact on daily operations
- Maintain ongoing communications with the user community in order to manage expectations
- Schedule ongoing weekend processing support and serve as on call support as needed
- Liaise with IT as needed to address issues with the servers and escalate as necessary to insure are resolved
- Completion of the successful decommission of a legacy database and file server hardware which included the migration of data, ETLs, jobs and files while minimizing impacts to day to day operations
- Coordination of a seamless migration of two production database servers from Windows and SQL 2008 to Windows 2012 and SQL Server 2014

positions.title: Project Manager/SSIS Developer/SQL DBA
positions.description:
- Administer seven servers running Windows 2008 server that act as both SQL 2008 and file servers
- Streamlined security by designing a security model based on Active Directory security groups
- Manage access requests to SQL server, file shares and team SharePoint sites
- Provide email support to peers within workgroup concerning topics including but not limited to data availability, best practices, definitions or explanations of datasets and access to servers or file shares  
- Develop and maintain ETL packages and processes using SSIS and VB .Net
- Establish processes that audit the production database servers to insure overall system integrity
- Install third party software as required by the business
- Document business and technical processes through Excel, Word and SharePoint wiki pages

positions.title: Corporate Sales and Revenue Senior Analyst
positions.description:
- Oversee the alignment of market share reporting between our US and International based teams
- Manage the relationship between our third party data vendor to insure timely and accurate analysis and reporting
- Lead the data management, analysis and reporting for the market share reporting
- Improve current reporting processes by migrating them from Access to using SSIS and VB .Net
- Perform ad hoc data analysis using custom t-SQL queries as needed by the business
Escalate problems requiring as needed in order to bring tough issues to resolution
Investigate technical issues with internal applications, websites and tools in order to provide feedback to the impacted business leads to assist with identifying and coming to some form of resolution
- Provide support concerning business processes and standards internal Hilton datasets and systems
- Answer emails and phone calls related to existing internal applications, websites and tools from corporate and hotel level team members alike.

positions.title: Programmer, Desktop Support/SQL Developer
positions.description:
Support 80 employees located at 1 central office and 3 remote offices including 15 servers
Converted servers and workstations to a new windows server domain
Exported and imported users emails to a new email server mandated by corporate policy
Recycled two scrapped computers creating working systems that were immediately deployed into production saving the company money
Facilitated the conversion of legacy weather data which included importing historical data from flat files into SQL using several C programs and creating a set of control tables
Experience with the installation process of a complete PBX telephone system
Reproduced a series of weather reports utilizing SQL views and stored procedures as a back-end and VBA as a front-end allowing for better control by the end user
Accepted responsibility of nightly backups, rotation of tapes, and off-site storage of week end tapes
Migrated an internal application from Oracle to SQL while making user requested improvements allowing those users to publish a better weekly report
Trained two new IT staff members on current procedures and practices
Achieved 100% Microsoft licensing compliance by auditing all desktops and servers
Improved existing program to include web-based access along with weekly automation which enabled the company to generate new revenue
Analyzed the costs associated with running and maintaining multiple laser printers used by the company exposing wasteful spending which initiated the purchase of three all-in-one machines cutting the cost by approximately 50 percent
Ability to troubleshoot problems, provide solutions, and provide feedback in plain English to the user
Traveled to St. Paul, MN to handle the technology installation of a new remote office including the necessary re-configuration of servers and desktops
Experience in upgrading to a VOIP telephone system

positions.title: Release & Classification Specialist
positions.description:
Analyzed paperwork as freight is received to determine eligibility of the freight to enter U.S. Commerce based on federal revenue laws set forth by U.S. Bureau of Customs and Border Protection and other governmental agencies 
Classified shipments through assigning tariff numbers to commodities in accordance with law 
Wrote entries on imported merchandise, considered import requirements and legal restrictions, and determined accurate duties and taxes
Submitted entries to U.S. Customs for approval and then released to ensure timely clearance of freight
Adapted to any changes made by the U.S. Government and those demanded by business need
Sustained high levels of productivity while maintaining quality and a very low error rate
